## Dependencies that changed after your training data

Your training data (`claude-sonnet-4-5`, cutoff 2025-07-31) predates the versions this project pins. When a note below conflicts with what you remember, follow the note: it describes the installed version. Tags: [types] = diff of the published type declarations, [changelog] = release notes, [summary] = summary of both.

**ai** 4.3.16 → 6.0.308 (major) (not imported directly)
- Removed; use the replacements: `CreateMessage` → `CreateUIMessage`, `CoreMessage` → `ModelMessage`, `convertToCoreMessages` → `convertToModelMessages`, `CoreToolCall` → `ToolCall`, `CoreToolResult` → `ToolResult`, `CoreTool` → `Tool`, `CoreToolCallUnion` → `ToolCallUnion`, `CoreToolChoice` → `ToolChoice` (+3 more). [types]
- `RequestOptions` was renamed to `CompletionRequestOptions` [types]
  Before: `import type { RequestOptions } from 'ai';` → After: `import type { CompletionRequestOptions } from 'ai';` (type-checked)
- `StreamData` was removed (it was deprecated: Please use `createDataStream`, `createDataStreamResponse`, and `pipeDataStreamToResponse` instead.) Changelog: “remove StreamData and mergeStreams” [types]
  Before: `data.append({ status: 'started' });` → After: `writer.write({ type: 'data-status', data: { status: 'started' } });` (type-checked)
- `tool()`: the `tool` argument no longer accepts `parameters`, `experimental_toToolResultContent`; the `tool` argument now requires `inputSchema` (The schema of the input that the tool expects). [types]
  Before: `const weather = tool({ parameters: z.object({ city: z.string() }), execute });` → After: `const weather = tool({ inputSchema: z.object({ city: z.string() }), execute });` (type-checked)
- `generateText()` options no longer accept `maxTokens`, `maxSteps`, `experimental_generateMessageId`, `experimental_continueSteps`, `experimental_providerMetadata`; use `maxOutputTokens` instead of `maxTokens`; new options include `stopWhen` (Condition for stopping the generation when there are tool results in the last step; default `stepCountIs(1)`). [types]
  Before: `const r = await generateText({ model, prompt, maxTokens: 512, maxSteps: 5 });` → After: `const r = await generateText({ model, prompt, maxOutputTokens: 512, stopWhen: stepCountIs(5) });` (type-checked)
- `streamText()` options no longer accept `maxTokens`, `maxSteps`, `toolCallStreaming`, `experimental_generateMessageId`, `experimental_continueSteps`, `experimental_providerMetadata` (+1 more); use `maxOutputTokens` instead of `maxTokens`; new options include `stopWhen` (Condition for stopping the generation when there are tool results in the last step; default `stepCountIs(1)`). [types]
- `ChatRequest` was removed. Changelog: “inline/remove ChatRequest type” [types]
- `Message` was removed. Changelog: “replace `Message` with `UIMessage`” [types]

**zod** 3.25.67 → 4.1.13 (major) (not imported directly)
- `string()`, `number()`, `boolean()`, `date()` options no longer accept `errorMap`, `invalid_type_error`, `required_error`, `description`, `coerce`; use `error` instead of `errorMap`. [types]
  Before: `const name = z.string({ required_error: "Name is required" });` → After: `const name = z.string({ error: "Name is required" });` (type-checked)
- `bigint()`, `symbol()`, `never()`, `array()` and 10 more options no longer accept `errorMap`, `invalid_type_error`, `required_error`, `description`; use `error` instead of `errorMap`. [types]
  Before: `const tags = z.array(z.string(), { errorMap: () => ({ message: "Expected an array" }) });` → After: `const tags = z.array(z.string(), { error: "Expected an array" });` (type-checked)
- `tuple()` no longer takes `schemas`; options no longer accept `errorMap`, `invalid_type_error`, `required_error`, `description`; use `error` instead of `errorMap`. [types]
  Before: `const pair = z.tuple([z.string(), z.number()], { invalid_type_error: "Expected a pair" });` → After: `const pair = z.tuple([z.string(), z.number()], { error: "Expected a pair" });` (type-checked)
- `instanceof()` options no longer accept `path`, `params`, `fatal`. [types]
  Before: `z.instanceof(File, { message: "Expected a file", path: ["upload"], fatal: true })` → After: `z.instanceof(File, { error: "Expected a file" })` (type-checked)
- `Refinement` was removed. Changelog: “replace 'Refinement' with 'Transform' in transforms section” [types]
- `nativeEnum` is deprecated: This API has been merged into `z.enum()`. Use `z.enum()` instead. [types]
- `ZodIssue` is deprecated: Use `z.core.$ZodIssue` from `@zod/core` instead, especially if you are building a library on top of Zod. [types]
- `IssueData` is deprecated: Use `z.core.$ZodRawIssue` instead. [types]

**next** 15.4.0 → 16.0.11 (major) (not imported directly)
- `unstable_rootParams` was removed (in `next/server`) Changelog: “[Breaking] Remove deprecated `unstable_rootParams`” [types]
  Before: `const { lang } = await unstable_rootParams()` → After: `const { lang } = await params` (type-checked)
- `revalidateTag()` now requires `profile` (`string | CacheLifeConfig`) (in `next/cache`) [types]
  Before: `revalidateTag('posts')` → After: `revalidateTag('posts', 'max')` (type-checked)
- `NextMiddleware` is deprecated: Use `NextProxy` instead. Middleware has been renamed to Proxy. (in `next/server`) [types]
  Before: `export const middleware: NextMiddleware = (request) => NextResponse.next();` → After: `export const proxy: NextProxy = (request) => NextResponse.next();` (type-checked)
- [Breaking] Remove deprecated sync access to Dynamic APIs. [changelog]
- [Breaking] Remove deprecated built-in AMP. [changelog]

Also newer than your training data, no notable API changes found: `react` 19.1.0 → 19.3.1, `react-dom` 19.1.0 → 19.3.1, `tsx` 4.20.3 → 4.20.6, `typescript` 5.8.3 → 6.0.3.
